create_ai_studio_model: create an AIStudioModel instance to generate content via Google AI Studio with text or image input
generate_with_openai_chat_completions: generate text completions using OpenAIChatCompletionsModel with streaming or non-streaming mode and optional image input
generate_with_anthropic_model: generate text responses using AnthropicModel with Claude models supporting extended thinking and streaming
process_openai_stream: process an OpenAI chat completions stream to extract main response, token usage, and reasoning tokens
unpack_thoughts_from_openai_response: unpack thinking tags from an OpenAI response to separate main response from reasoning thoughts
